# `TextLayoutRequest$Alignment`

**Kind:** enum  
**Module/package:** `com.pdfdancer.common.request`  
**SDK:** `com.pdfdancer.client:pdfdancer-client-java 3.0.3`

Explicit alignment of each edited line. Valid only for text replace.

Each edited line keeps its original visible text extent as the reference:
LEFT keeps the left edge, RIGHT keeps the right edge, CENTERED
keeps the midpoint, and JUSTIFIED keeps both edges by changing the word gaps
(the last line of a paragraph stays left-aligned).
